init.title: Reconfigure Tecnoalarm
init.description: Update the panel connection, credentials and polling interval. When you save, polling and keepalives pause and the current session disconnects before authentication. On success the integration reloads; on failure the previous settings resume. Polling interval: 1–600 seconds (default 30). Each poll connects, authenticates, reads status and disconnects. Set to 0 to keep authentication open with a keepalive every 5 seconds and status reads every 30 seconds.

error.invalid_auth: The panel rejected the user code.
error.invalid_config: Check host, port, hexadecimal APPID, passphrase, numeric user code and polling interval (an integer from 0 to 600).
error.cannot_connect: Unable to authenticate with the panel. Check connectivity and the direct passphrase.

user.title: Connect to Tecnoalarm
user.description: Read-only direct panel access. Authentication is required. APPID is hexadecimal; user code must contain 4–6 digits. Polling interval: 1–600 seconds (default 30). Each poll connects, authenticates, reads status and disconnects. Set to 0 to keep authentication open with a keepalive every 5 seconds and status reads every 30 seconds.
